project_description: AI-based wedding seat planner and guest management app for brides: track guests across multiple events, generate a spatial room layout (tables, dance floor, key elements) from a text description, assign guests to tables through an intuitive drag-and-drop flow, and export the finished seating chart to PDF. Usability and flexibility are both first-class: it should never frustrate users by refusing what they want, while staying effortless for the common path.
design_context: Designed for a bride: beautiful, streamlined, not over the top. The color scheme and ease of use carry the experience. Elegant, calm, celebratory - never generic SaaS.
